findings.label: Dark-only placeholder in LogVisitModal
findings.detail: placeholderTextColor={t.scheme === 'dark' ? t.color.textSecondary : undefined} departs from the design's unconditional TextInput rule, to keep light identical (the input had no placeholder colour before). B2 used the same pattern. Integrator: record it as a design clarification so B4-B7 apply one rule.

findings.label: extraData array rebuilt every render in FoodItemPickerModal
findings.detail: extraData={[selectedItems, t.scheme]} is a new array on every parent render, so FlatList's shallow compare never skips a render (previously selectedItems was a stable reference). Suggest wrapping it in useMemo. The plan sanctions this form, and the cost is performance only.

findings.label: No render coverage for AddToTripOrListChoiceSheet / AddToTripPickerSheet
findings.detail: No test renders either sheet in either scheme, so the statusMeta(t) refactor and the primaryFg icon swaps rely on the guard and screenshots. The plan acknowledges this. LogVisitModal and RestaurantDishLogCard dark palettes are likewise unasserted (they are rendered only by light-mode B2 tests).

findings.label: Pre-batch uncommitted edits show up in git diff HEAD
findings.detail: keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled" in CreateLocationModal.tsx (x2) and FoodItemPickerModal.tsx (x1) is already in the B3 snapshot, so it isn't B3's work. It still appears against HEAD, and the integrator should know it before committing.

findings.label: Typecheck evidence summarised, not pasted
findings.detail: C5 reports 'no error TS lines, exit=0' plus a per-file TS-API count, not the literal tsc tail. Adequate for a batch gate. W3 npm run verify remains the binding check.
